title: Brooklyn Navy Yard Building 203 Boiler Plant and Building 365 Substation & Boiler Projects
agency_path: City of New York > Brooklyn Navy Yard Development Corp.
submit_to: Building 77, 141 Flushing Avenue, Suite 801, Brooklyn, NY 11205
description_text:
Bid documents will be available as of October 7th, 2026. Link: BNYDC website https://brooklynnavyyard.org/contract-opportunities

A Mandatory pre-bid conference will be held at 8:30 AM on Tuesday, October 20th, at the Brooklyn Navy Yard Offices, 141 Flushing Avenue, Building 77, Suite 801, Brooklyn, NY 11205. Failure to attend will result in disqualification. Anyone wishing to submit a bid must attend the meeting. All attendees must R.S.V.P. using the pre-registration link available in the bid documents. Contact David Magdich via email at bid@bnydc.org with any questions regarding this conference and site visit.
